name: Yuuma
source:
An individual under Tatebayashi's command who possesses supernatural powers. 
He is not originally a military man, but has become Tatebayashi's subordinate for a certain purpose. He is a man of few words, but he is the most skilled swordsman in the Tatebayashi's squad.
He saved many lives during the explosion accident that occurred a year ago.
Shigure has a deep-seated grudge against him and attacks him at every opportunity. 

"I don't have time to deal with you... There is someone waiting for me."
